protocol.timed_region: Fresh process to exit including reading the same regular stdin file, encoding, every hash lookup/update, output and JIT initialization; AOT builds/input generation/validation excluded.
protocol.source_scope: Mech .mec only; generic experimental collection compiler/runtime excluded. Competitors: complete unchanged upstream programs. New operations are not yet wired into the general v0.4 resident catalog.
protocol.source_metric: Comment removal, whitespace collapse, UTF-8 gzip level1 mtime0; nonblank noncomment LOC also reported.
protocol.required_work: All overlapping windows for k=1,2,3,4,6,12,18 counted using growing library hash maps; no periodicity shortcut or query-only counting.
protocol.correctness: Every candidate must match unmodified Rust #7 full output byte-for-byte, checked against published full output. Official N=1000 failures are retained and flagged; strict endpoints additionally require passing the small reference.
